question: Please list the average number of prenatal weeks in 2018 for counties in Wisconsin where more than 5% of the employed population had commutes of 45-59 minutes in 2017.
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.geo_id) AS num_counties, AVG(n.Ave_Number_of_Prenatal_Wks) AS avg_prenatal_weeks
FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality` n
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr` c
  ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c.geo_id
WHERE n.Year = '2018-01-01'
  AND c.geo_id LIKE '55%'
  AND c.employed_pop > 0
  AND SAFE_DIVIDE(c.commute_45_59_mins, c.employed_pop) * 100 > 5
